claims.claim_summary: Semi-OPD beats OPD on 14/17 pairs with up to 13.6% accuracy gain
claims.claim_text_verbatim: Across 17 teacher–student pairs ranging from 1.5B to 235B parameters, Semi-OPD outperforms OPD in 14 cases, with up to +13.6% accuracy and 11.4× training speedup.

evidence_spans.source_text: We evaluate across 17 teacher–student pairs spanning 1.5B to 235B parameters and three model families in both thinking and non-thinking modes
We find that Semi-OPD outperforms OPD on 14 of them, with up to ~13% over OPD at the last step as shown in Fig. 1, and achieves comparable performance (within a 0.1%–2.6% gap) on the remaining three.
